compareDisposition.rationale: The curator examined Jacob’s captivity turns toward restoration beside Return from the nations is promised after return to God; Exiles are called to praise toward restored Jerusalem; Jerusalem speaks hope to children carried away; Jerusalem is told to watch the gathering. Those passages share its Eden-and-exile evidence group or canonical movement, but none supplies a distinct two-source relationship stronger than the accepted comparisons already carrying this topic.
